answer: The knoll lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the forge is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
